summary: David pleads with the Lord to hear his prayers—The reproof of the righteous is a kindness.
meta_description: David pleads with the Lord to hear his prayers—The reproof of the righteous is a kindness.

footnotes.note5_a: JST Ps. 141:5 When the righteous smite me with the word of the Lord it is a kindness; and when they reprove me, it shall be an excellent oil, and shall not destroy my faith; for yet my prayer also shall be for them. I delight not in their calamities.
